scope: Corollary 1.2 of the manuscript “Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree” (preprints/Deterministic-nonbipartite-Ramanujan-graphs-in-every-fixed-degree-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 178 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d8ea4bb85aae750), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed d ≥ 3, a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm, on every sufficiently large integer input N, produces a simple connected nonbipartite d-regular Ramanujan graph G with N ≤ |V (G)| ≤ N + 1 ≤ 2N.
